findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "bring_your_document" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_a_feature" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: business_teardown, review_intelligence, compose_report, start_an_engagement · Private data: data_source_atlas, what_we_have_for_you, twin_cities_lookup, twin_cities_datasets, twin_cities_records, bring_your_document, start_an_engagement, request_a_feature · Public sink: pricing_benchmark, start_an_engagement, request_a_feature · Destructive: business_teardown, local_visibility_audit, broker_diligence_prep, compose_report, start_an_engagement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: business_teardown, review_intelligence, compose_report, start_an_engagement · Private data: data_source_atlas, what_we_have_for_you, twin_cities_lookup, twin_cities_datasets, twin_cities_records, bring_your_document, start_an_engagement, request_a_feature · Public sink: pricing_benchmark, start_an_engagement, request_a_feature · Destructive: business_teardown, local_visibility_audit, broker_diligence_prep, compose_report, start_an_engagement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
